# scon_connection (Resource)

The connection records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connector` (String) A slug from `GET /api/connectors`
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) Trimmed, required non empty

### Optional

- `config` (Dynamic) The connector's fields by key. A key whose connector field has `secret: true` is write only and sensitive: it is moved out of `config` into a samna secret owned by the connection (`secret.PutSecrets`), never stored on the row, and read back as `********`. On a replace a secret key sent as an empty string is removed and one left out or sent as `********` keeps its stored value. `signing_secret`, on connectors that have it, is generated when absent and returned once.
- `state` (String) `active` on create
